tasks.gr7-listening-speaking-t3: Topic: Listening and Speaking (Grade 7 Term 3). Cover culture, environment, folktales, opinion giving, and interviews. Ask learners to choose suitable retell sequences, identify respectful opinion phrases with reasons, respond to interview prompts, and select effective oral interaction behaviours.
tasks.gr7-reading-viewing-t3: Topic: Reading and Viewing (Grade 7 Term 3). Cover poems, folktales, posters, short factual texts, and picture sequences. Ask learners to identify mood and message, retrieve important details, interpret poster visuals, order sequence cards logically, and answer comprehension items with textual evidence.
tasks.gr7-writing-presenting-t3: Topic: Writing and Presenting (Grade 7 Term 3). Cover invitations, short reports, directions, cultural paragraphs, and recounts. Ask learners to recognise correct format features, order ideas clearly, choose effective transition words, and improve draft quality through punctuation and feedback checks.
tasks.gr7-language-structures-t3: Topic: Language Structures (Grade 7 Term 3). Cover connectors, conjunctions, past and future tense, concords, and punctuation. Ask learners to choose suitable linking words, correct agreement errors, maintain tense consistency, and edit short passages for sentence flow and punctuation accuracy.
